text: dsh-branch-companion 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的会话分支插件。选中对话中的一段文字后，可从当前会话创建子会话，并把选中文字作为引用预填到新会话。插件在原文旁显示可点击标记，并提供按来源会话分组的分支树面板，用于展开、折叠、跳转和移除分支节点。分支关系保存在浏览器 localStorage；使用时需要 DSH Web UI 和 0.2.x 运行时，不需要额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-branch-companion adds session branching to DSH Web. Select conversation text to fork a child session with the quote in its draft. Source markers and a branch tree support navigation and cleanup. Branch links stay in browser localStorage. Requires DSH Web UI and runtime 0.2.x.
我想把回答里选中的一段单独开个会话继续追问。
能不能从对话中的一段引用创建分支，并方便回到原文？
I want to branch a conversation from a selected passage and keep a navigable history of related sessions.
dsh-branch-companion 的功能「从选文创建会话分支」：在对话文字上选中至少两个字符后，点击选区下方的操作按钮即可分叉当前会话，打开子会话并将引用文本预填到输入草稿中。
dsh-branch-companion 的功能「分支树与原文标记」：页面右上角的分支面板按来源会话展示父子节点，可展开、折叠、跳转或移除节点；若引用仍能在原文中匹配，旁边会出现点击后打开目标分支的标记。

description: "Selection branching for the Web client: grow a Session branch from selected transcript text, with source markers and a navigable branch tree."

dsh-branch-companion README · dsh-branch-companion：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

dsh-branch-companion README · Overview：`dsh-branch-companion` adds one path the Web client does not have: growing a branch out of a passage. Selecting text in a transcript reveals **Add to new branch**; choosing it forks the current Session through the Host, opens the child, records the reference, leaves a clickable ⑂ marker beside the quoted text, and keeps a navigable tree in the top-right corner.

dsh-branch-companion README · Overview：The node document lives in the browser (`localStorage`). The Host gains no service and no event; removing the plugin takes away the panel and the markers and nothing else.

dsh-branch-companion README · Features：- **Branch from a selection**: select any passage in an answer or question; **Add to new branch** appears under it and forks the current Session into a child.
- **Context preserved**: the child keeps the context up to the fork point and prefills `About this passage: "…"`.
- **Source markers**: a ⑂ marker sits beside the quoted text, re-anchors on scroll, re-render, and streaming, and jumps back to the branch.
- **Branch tree panel**: the **⑂ Branch** pill at the top right opens a panel grouped by source Session with parent/child nesting; every level expands and collapses (plus a collapse-all control), and the current branch carries a highlighted dot.
- **Jump and prune**: click a node to jump; hover ✕ to remove that node and its sub-branches without deleting the Session.
- **Client-only state**: nodes live in browser `localStorage`; the Host gains no service or event, and removing the plugin takes only the panel and markers.
dsh-branch-companion README · Features：

dsh-branch-companion README · Usage：1. **Create a branch from the answer**: select "cyclic prefix (CP)" and choose **Add to new branch** under the selection.
2. **Continue in the branch**: the child Session opens with `About this passage: "cyclic prefix (CP)"` already in the composer; ask the follow-up there.
3. **Return to the source**: a ⑂ marker appears beside the quoted text; click it to jump back, and it re-anchors after scrolling.
4. **See the whole tree**: open the **⑂ Branch** pill at the top right; click a node to jump, hover ✕ to remove a node (the Session stays).

dsh-branch-companion README · Usage：> Screenshot walkthrough: the ChatGPT / Codex desktop edition, [chatgpt-desktop-branch-companion](https://github.com/Tetro02/chatgpt-desktop-branch-companion), shares the same core interaction (select → branch → marker → tree panel). The DSH edition runs in the DSH Web UI and keeps nodes in browser `localStorage`.

dsh-branch-companion README · Interactions：| Action | Result |
|---|---|
| Select text in a transcript | **Add to new branch** appears under the selection |
| Choose it | Forks the current Session, opens the child, prefills `About this passage: "…"` |
| ⑂ marker beside the quote | Jumps to the branch; re-anchors on scroll, re-render, and streaming output |
| **⑂ Branch** pill, top right | Opens the tree; click a node to jump, hover ✕ to remove it and its sub-branches |
| Branch from inside a branch | The child node hangs under its parent and indents accordingly |

dsh-branch-companion README · Installation：This package is itself a DSH bundle: it declares `dsh.bundle`, ships its own `cordis.patch.yml`, and needs no manual Loader edit.

Install it with the plugin manager (`plugin_manager`, `action: install_bundle`), passing either spec:

- the repository URL: `https://github.com/Tetro02/dsh-branch-companion`
- a local checkout: `file:C:\path\to\dsh-branch-companion`

dsh-branch-companion README · Installation：The manager writes the profile dependency, selects the bundle, and applies its patch layer live; `remove_bundle` reverts the profile completely. A DSH 0.2.x runtime and the Web UI are required — the Host half exists only so the client half can be composed.

dsh-branch-companion README · Understand the implementation：<details>
<summary>Implementation details — click to expand</summary>

dsh-branch-companion README · Design：The plugin does three things, all in the browser: turn a selection into a fork, record the fork relationship, and draw that record back beside the source text. It registers no slot and renders no React node, so the transcript's own tree is untouched; the price is a dependency on DOM contracts (`[data-conversation-content]`, `[data-conversation-session]`).

dsh-branch-companion README · Design：Markers never wrap text. The plugin concatenates the transcript's text nodes, matches the stored quote with whitespace-insensitive patterns, builds a Range to measure `getBoundingClientRect()`, and positions an absolutely placed badge to its right. When React re-renders, the next paint measures the new nodes.

dsh-branch-companion README · Source map：| File | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `src/index.ts` | Host half: exists so the Loader can compose the client bundle; no services, no state |
| `src/client/index.ts` | Browser entry: registers dictionaries, mounts the overlay, hands teardown to the plugin fiber |
| `src/client/overlay.ts` | Selection action, source markers, branch panel, prefill retry |
| `src/client/anchor.ts` | Re-anchors a stored quote to the live transcript and returns a Range |
| `src/client/quote.ts` | Quote normalization and whitespace-tolerant matching (pure, unit-tested) |
| `src/client/tree.ts` | Node document parsing, parent/child queries, subtree removal, depth (pure, unit-tested) |
| `src/client/types.ts` | Structural types for the client services used here (no DSH type imports) |
| `scripts/build.mjs` | esbuild emits the Host ESM and the wrapped browser bundle; tsc emits declarations |

dsh-branch-companion README · Flow：Selection → `sessions.fork({ sessionId, increaseTitle: true })` → child id → append and persist the node → `uiWorkspace.openSession(childId)` → poll `sessions.binding(childId)` and `conversation.input.requestDraftInitialization` to prefill (up to 15 attempts, 200 ms apart, silent on failure). -----

dsh-branch-companion README · Further exploration：- Fork semantics belong to `sessions.fork` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller`; title increment and the `atSeq` boundary come from there. - Navigation belongs to `uiWorkspace.openSession` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace`. - Composer prefill belongs to `conversation.input.requestDraftInitialization` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation`.

dsh-branch-companion README · Model experience：None directly. The plugin registers no tool, injects no prompt, and sends no message; any difference between a source Session and its branch comes from the user's own input.
dsh-branch-companion README · Token impact：Zero. No system-prompt paragraph, no runtime-context line.
dsh-branch-companion README · KV cache impact：None. The plugin neither assembles nor sends provider requests.

dsh-branch-companion README · Known limitations and deferred work：- **The Host picks the fork point**: `sessions.fork` cuts at the last completed turn by default; the selected text is context and a node reference, not a precise cut.
- **No forking while streaming**: the Host rejects a fork on an unfinished turn; the plugin reports it once.
- **Markers need the text**: if the message is collapsed or rewritten, the quote no longer matches and no marker is drawn, while the node stays in the panel.
- **The panel is an overlay**: it covers the right pane and must be collapsed; no sidebar slot is used.
- **The document is per origin**: a different host or port yields a new `localStorage` and the old document does not follow.
- **No Host configuration**: thresholds (600-character quote cap, 40 markers, retry count) are build-time constants, not Schemastery fields.
- **Compared with the ChatGPT desktop edition**: tree nodes have no keyboard navigation or removal undo yet; nodes live in `localStorage` instead of a `branch-state.json` file.
